programme.desc: Tatuerarna måste överträffa Ink Masters vinnare för att få en chans till upprättelse. Nick D'Angelo, Ryan Eternal, Jason Clay Dunn och Steve Tefft återvänder.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: Mycket står på spel när tatuerarna måste göra den ultimata ansiktstatueringen. Rivaliserande pakter försöker ta kontroll över spelet i elimineringstatueringen.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: Allt vänds mot veteranerna när de nya tatuerarna får bestämma i elimineringstävlingen och äntligen får sin revansch. Kampen om en plats i live-finalen är mer intensiv än nånsin.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av 'Ridiculousness' ser Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood hemska skejtarskador i 'Skejtaransiktslyft', kraschar slädar i 'Snöfatad' och skadas på gymmet med 'Hakfall'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness har Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood noll campingerfarenhet i 'Inomhusmän', avslutar spelet i 'Bakplattskrossare' samt går överstyr vid baren och blir 'Rättvist utkastade'.

programme.title: Ink Master
programme.desc: I snabbutmaningen målar tatuerarna med rök. Glittertatueringar och en ny vändning gör dagens tatueringar viktigare än nånsin.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vincent Van Gogh : une nouvelle façon de voir
programme.desc: La vie de Vincent van Gogh reste entourée de mystère : folie, maladie, suicide, les ingrédients pour créer un mythe sont tous réunis. Bénéficiant d’un accès complet et sans précédent aux trésors du Van Gogh Museum d’Amsterdam, ce documentaire met en lumière à la fois l’un des artistes préférés du monde et la collection riche et unique du musée. Découvrez ces merveilleux chefs-d’œuvre sur grand écran pendant que quelques invités y compris les conservateurs de renommée mondiale et des historiens de l’art offrent leurs interprétations et des explications sur le travail de Van Gogh.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Construction of the cathedral began in 1247 and was only finished in 1880 after an interruption that lasted more than 300 years. Ribbed vaults and flying buttresses, the film explores the architectural vocabulary of the gothic style and its building methods. It reveals the most recent contribution of metal to architecture. It demonstrates how this cathedral that embodies German unity is at the same time archetypal of the Gothic style and of a 19th century building.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Le street Art s’est, depuis les années 1980, glissé dans les villes et ses artistes s’octroient une place grandissante dans l’espace urbain, mais aussi dans les collections d’art. Installé à Lille, Jef Aerosol fait partie des historiques du Street Art français avec option pochoir. Son genre, c’est le portrait, et il a longtemps puisé dans l’univers musical pour décliner sa passion. L’artiste est collectionné aujourd’hui par les plus grands amateurs de Street Art.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous irons à la rencontre de l’artiste Annette Messager. Ses créations bousculent la scène contemporaine depuis presque 50 ans. Elle est l’un des plus grands artistes français récompensée par un lion d’or à la Biennale de Venise en 2005. Elle emploi tissu, et objets du quotidien pour représenter l’intime. Mais elle reste aussi une artiste engagée. Installée dans la banlieue populaire de Paris, Annette Messager nous reçoit dans son atelier.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Auguste Renoir. You will discover his labour with Girls at the piano, The Bathers, still-life with apples and pears.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Raphaël. You will discover his labour with Spozalizio, The virgin and child with St John the Baptist or portrait of Baldassare Castiglione.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: En 2013, la Norvège célébra le 150e anniversaire de la naissance d'Edvard Munch (1863-1944), l'une des figures proéminentes de l'art moderne. Munch 150, coproduite par le Musée national et le Musée Munch, est déjà acclamée comme « l'exposition d'une vie ». L'intérêt général est énorme, comme le témoigne le résultat record de la mise aux enchères publiques de l'un de ses quatre tableaux, Le Cri, soit 120 millions de dollars. Cette présentation vous amènera dans les coulisses de la mise en place de cette exposition, en plus de comprendre une visite guidée de la Norvège qui brossera la biographie de cet homme dont la vie s'est étalée de la moitié du 19ème siècle jusqu'à l'occupation allemande lors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Tout à la fois peintre et diplomate, Pierre-Paul Rubens (1577-1640) fut un personnage essentiel dans l’Europe artistique du XVIIe siècle. Il créa de vastes compositions pour les familles princières d’alors, comme le cycle sur la vie de Marie de Médicis, aujourd’hui conservé au musée du Louvre. Il incarne la veine baroque du Nord de l’Europe, développant un style tout en mouvement et aux touches colorées lumineuses, comme dans l’Enlèvement des filles de Leucippe exposé à Munich.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or rediscover the masterpieces by Gustave Moreau (1826-1898) on display at the Musée d'Orsay, the Gustave Moreau Museum in Paris...

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: This is a traditional wooden townhouse built in 1743 in the center of Kyoto. Destroyed by fire in 1864, it was rebuilt identically 4 years later. Invisible codes hierarchize the use of spaces. There are no walls or windows, "it's an accumulation of voids". This fluid, flexible space is a source of inspiration for contemporary architecture.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vincent Van Gogh : une nouvelle façon de voir
programme.desc: La vie de Vincent van Gogh reste entourée de mystère : folie, maladie, suicide, les ingrédients pour créer un mythe sont tous réunis. Bénéficiant d’un accès complet et sans précédent aux trésors du Van Gogh Museum d’Amsterdam, ce documentaire met en lumière à la fois l’un des artistes préférés du monde et la collection riche et unique du musée. Découvrez ces merveilleux chefs-d’œuvre sur grand écran pendant que quelques invités y compris les conservateurs de renommée mondiale et des historiens de l’art offrent leurs interprétations et des explications sur le travail de Van Gogh.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or rediscover the masterpieces of the Dutch national museum Rijksmuseum with artists such as Rembrandt, Vermeer...

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Museo del Prado in Madrid holds one of the biggest collections of paintings in the world. The “Garden of Delights”, a triptych by Hieronymus Bosch, is one of its jewels. But naturally it is the Spanish School which predominates, with masterpieces by Velasquez and Goya. Look at Velasquez’s famous “Las Meninas” in which the painter portrays himself next to the Infanta and her followers. And admire the sensuous beauty of Goya’s “La Maja Desnuda” or the political force of “El Tres de Mayo”.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Art Poster in Paris Streets
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, illustrated posters turned Paris into an open-air museum. From Chéret to Toulouse-Lautrec, artists and audiences met in the streets. This film explores this graphic revolution and its impact on society and modernity.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The Birth of Venus... a masterpiece; central to Botticelli's oeuvre and the culmination of Florentine Neoplatonism.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: During the 20th century, the fame of the ‘Mona Lisa’ spread, establishing itself as the most iconic and recognisable painting of all time. It has been exploited in every sphere of culture and advertising, to the extent that its status as a pop icon has almost overshadowed its artistic value and historical significance. But if we consider Leonardo’s achievements as a pioneering craftsman and the unprecedented qualities of this work, the ‘Mona Lisa’ truly marked a turning point in portraiture. A masterpiece that set new standards in its day and which, five hundred years later, has become the very symbol of art.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to the discovery of the exhibition " Split air – Bamboo art in Japan " at the Quai Branly Jacques Chirac Museum. Bamboo art in Japan appeared quite late but continues today thanks to contemporary artists. Throughout this exhibition we will be able to observe works from different periods of this movement.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Goya: Visions of Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: Francisco Goya, considéré comme le fondateur de l’art moderne, est l’artiste espagnol le plus acclamé. En plus d’observer avec talent la vie et le passé mouvementé de l’Espagne, c’est un portraitiste doué et un commentateur social par excellence. Avec Goya, l’art du portrait atteint de nouveaux sommets. Cette exposition majeure de la National Gallery de Londres remet son génie en lumière. À travers une formidable collection d’oeuvres uniques et de lettres de Goya, nous analysons l’homme lui-même et le monde qu’il peignait.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Peintre originaire de Florence en Italie, Sandro Botticelli est considéré comme l’un des peintres Italiens les plus connus du 15ème siècle. Proche de la famille Medici, il est admiré et renommé pour ses portraits et ses peintures de femmes nues tout droit inspirées de la mythologie grecques comme le majestic tableau « La naissance de Vénus », exhibé dans la Gallery Uffizi à Florence, et également présent dans cet épisode.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Rembrandt: without a doubt the greatest painter in the Netherlands. Admired all over the world, especially for his play with light and dark. He was a Dutch celebrity avant la lettre, the superstar of the Golden Age ... A master of portraying human emotions, especially when it comes to his self-portraits. Technical virtuoso, but also ruthlessly honest. Rembrant painted his first self-portrait when he was 22. A small, but technically very refined work: "Self-portrait at an early age." Is the team able to unravel some of the secrets of Rembrandt's shadow play?

programme.title: Custom Revolution
programme.desc: In this documentary, we take you on a tour of the world's first custom motorcycle exhibit.

programme.title: Digital Arts: (R)evolution?
programme.desc: From the Hybrid Layers exhibition to the center of contemporary artists' thoughts, we have traveled the paths of reality to explore its boundaries.

programme.title: Warning ! Fresh paint
programme.desc: Since April 2018, the museum « La Piscine de Roubaix » prepare the extension of the exposition surface. In six months, thousand of works will be pick up, cleaned, restored and reinstalled.

programme.title: St+art India
programme.desc: In the heart of India, Bombay welcome the festival ST+ART, one of the most big urban arts festival in the country. Discover the backstage of the event and understand the relation between the habitants, artists and monumental murals.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Rembrandt at the National Gallery, London & Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Il y a une grande simplicité et un réalisme troublant dans les figures du peintre lorrain Georges de La Tour (1593-1652). Marqué par les œuvres du Caravage, il a produit des œuvres aux tonalités claires, comme la fameuse composition du Tricheur à l’as de carreau, mais aussi de nombreuses scènes nocturnes, au clair-obscur saisissant, simplement éclairées par la lumière d’une chandelle, comme dans Le nouveau-né ou l’Adoration des bergers actuellement conservé au Louvre à Paris.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Dans le quartier de Palmeiras à Sao Paulo, une ancienne usine aligne ses ateliers du début du XXème siècle avec d’étranges blocs de béton qui se dressent face à la ville et à ses tours. Un centre social et culturel destiné aux employés du commerce. Son architecte Lina Bo Bardi préfère parler d’une "citadelle du loisir

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous vous parlerons de l’artiste Antoine Bourdelle. Fils de menuisier monté à la capitale, Antoine Bourdelle devient, au début du XXe siècle, le plus grand sculpteur officiel. Cet élève de Rodin a répondu à de nombreuses commandes en France et à l’étranger. Mais il a aussi conservé certaines de ses sculptures encore aujourd’hui présentes dans son atelier du quartier Montparnasse, un lieu magique, resté comme figé dans le passé.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, on relève le piquant avec les gastronomes gourmets Tony Singh et Cyrus Todiwala. Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Photo Contest

They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Franco-Danish painter, Camille Pissarro. You will discover his labour with View from Louveciennes, A path through the fields, Pontoise or Peasant girl making a fire.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Prussian painter, Caspar David Friedrich. You will discover his labour with The Wanderer above the mists, Greifswald port or the Lone tree.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Le musée d’Orsay, qui fut d'abord une gare construite pour l'Exposition universelle de 1900, abrite la production artistique du monde occidental sur la période de 1848 à 1914. De nombreux courants artistiques y sont présentés : académisme, réalisme, symbolisme, Art nouveau, et bien sur l’impressionnisme avec des œuvres et des artistes incontournables tels que l’Olympia de Manet, le Bal du moulin de la galette de Renoir, l’Etoile de Degas ou le Cirque de Seurat.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: La Casa Milà, que l'on appelle communément "la Pedrera

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Goya: Visions of Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: Francisco Goya, considéré comme le fondateur de l’art moderne, est l’artiste espagnol le plus acclamé. En plus d’observer avec talent la vie et le passé mouvementé de l’Espagne, c’est un portraitiste doué et un commentateur social par excellence. Avec Goya, l’art du portrait atteint de nouveaux sommets. Cette exposition majeure de la National Gallery de Londres remet son génie en lumière. À travers une formidable collection d’oeuvres uniques et de lettres de Goya, nous analysons l’homme lui-même et le monde qu’il peignait.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: This gallery was built in the 16th century as the seat for Florence’s new administrative offices (uffizi), and opened to the public as the Uffizi Gallery in the 18th century. Today it still offers the world’s most beautiful collection of Italian Renaissance art. How could anyone remain insensitive to the sensual beauty of “The Birth of Venus” by Botticelli, “The Venus of Urbino” by Titian, or Correggio’s “Danae”? Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: St+art India
programme.desc: In the heart of India, Bombay welcome the festival ST+ART, one of the most big urban arts festival in the country. Discover the backstage of the event and understand the relation between the habitants, artists and monumental murals.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The 5 Masterpieces of the Museum of Modern Art – Paris
programme.desc: In 2010, five masterpieces by Picasso, Matisse, Braque, Modigliani and Léger went missing. A year into the investigation, the police arrested the burglar, Vrejan Tomic. A repeat offender, with 11 art thefts to his name, he usually works to order. In this case, the client was Jean-Michel Corvez. Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Painting the Modern Garden - Monet to Matisse
programme.desc: Passionné d’horticulture, Monet reste sans conteste le maître de la peinture de jardins dans l’histoire de l’art, mais il n’était pas seul. Des artistes tels que Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso et Matisse ont utilisé le jardin comme thème fort de leur œuvre. Ces grands artistes, ainsi que bien d’autres noms célèbres, sont rassemblés dans une exposition innovante du Cleveland Museum of Art et de la Royal Gallery of Arts de Londres. De l’exposition elle-même à la beauté des jardins d’artistes comme celui de Monet à Giverny, nous partons en voyage pour découvrir comment le jardin moderne était utilisé pour explorer de nouvelles idées radicales et merveilleuses.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Léonard De Vinci est le peintre Italien de la renaissance le plus célèbre. Il possède un talent inégalable (peintre, sculpteur, architecte, ingénieur, urbaniste, mathématicien, botaniste, philosophe, inventeur,…) Il a considérablement influencé l’histoire de l’art. Son usage de la technique Sfumato et du clair-obscur son encore étudié aujourd’hui. La « Mona Lisa » et « La Cène » exposé au Louvre et dans l'église Santa Maria delle Grazie qui apparaissent dans cet épisode font partie de ses peintures les plus renommé, admiré et parodié à travers le monde.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Karel Appel’s father forced him to take over the hairdressing business, but Karel only wanted one thing: to become a painter. And he did: A great master ahead of his time, a world famous painter even. In 1949, when he was still unknown and penniless, he made "Child, Church, Animal". Actually nothing is known about the construction of this painting. Not more than you can discover at first sight. To find out more, we have to take a closer look at the work using a microscope. It seems as if the work consists of several layers.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Après deux ans d’exposition itinérante, en 2015 "La Jeune Fille à la perle” est retournée au musée Mauritshuis de La Haye. Du haut de ses 350 ans, l’éternelle Jeune Fille a toujours su conserver son aura de mystère et son charme. La preuve, c’est le nombre de curieux (1,2 millions) qui ont accouru pour l’apercevoir lors de son séjour au Japon. Le documentaire cherche à découvrir les nombreuses énigmes de cet extraordinaire tableau et de son créateur mystérieux - Vermeer. Qui était cette fille ? Pourquoi et comment Vermeer a-t-il peint ce tableau ? Venez voyager dans le temps pour découvrir Johannes Vermeer, visiter le charmant musée de La Haye et répondre à toutes ces questions.

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc: A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. This film offers a portrait full of contradictions.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Les impressionnistes - et l'homme qui les a créés
programme.desc: Ce sont les artistes les plus populaires du monde. Les œuvres de Cézanne, Monet, Degas et leurs compatriotes représentent des richesses inestimables. Mais qui étaient-ils vraiment ? Comment et pourquoi ont-ils révolutionné l’histoire de l’art ? Qu’est-ce qui se cache derrière leur succès intemporel ? Pour répondre à ces questions, le documentaire a obtenu un accès unique à une grande exposition mettant l’accent sur le collectionneur d’art parisien du 19ème siècle, Paul Durand-Ruel, l’expert des Impressionnistes qui prit la décision courageuse d’exposer les Impressionnistes à New York en 1886 et ainsi introduire la société américaine à la peinture française moderne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Michelangelo Merisi (1571-1610), born in Caravaggio, is known as a wicked artist who had to flee Rome in 1606 after killing a man. But Caravaggio is above all a painter who changed the face of painting at the very beginning of the 17th century. Notice his use of colour in the people emerging from a dark background, like his “Bacchus” or “David”. One of his masterpieces is the cycle of the “Calling of Saint Matthew” in the chapel of the church of St- Louis-of-the-French in Rome.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: L'histoire des hôtels de Rohan et de Soubise, c'est l'histoire d'une folle ambition qui va animer la maison des princes de Soubise dans leur rêve de grandeur de 1705 à 1752. L'ambition du prince est double : transformer l'hôtel de Guise en hôtel de Soubise pour le prince héritier, et faire construire un deuxième hôtel pour le cinquième fils, le prince-évêque de Strasbourg. Deux hôtels se font face, séparés par un beau jardin dans le coeur historique de la ville. Au fur et à mesure des différentes campagnes de travaux, rien ne sera trop beau pour les princes de Soubise. Un ensemble urbain paradoxal qui témoigne à la fois du modèle parisien « entre cour et jardin » et de l'invention des architectes pour l'adapter à une parcelle irrégulière, et une illustration du rôle politique des bâtiments pour l'aristocratie française du 18ème siècle.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans l’Ouest de la banlieue parisienne, nous allons à la découverte de l’atelier de l’artiste Jérôme Zonder. Depuis plus de 10 ans, l’artiste développe un travail virtuose centré sur le dessin. Réalisés au fusain ou à la mine de graphite, ses œuvres sombres et souvent très réalistes suscitent à la fois admiration et effroi. Puissant et complexe, l’art de Jérôme Zonder captive par ses prouesses techniques et questionne notre rapport à la violence.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous rencontrerons l’artiste Ben. Actif sur la scène de la création contemporaine depuis plus de 50 ans, il est un personnage autodidacte aux multiples facettes. Son succès est indéniable. Si son statut d’artiste s’affirme à travers ses célèbres écritures peintes en lettres cursives blanches sur fond noir, son tempérament de « touche à tout » a fait de lui l’une des personnalités artistiques les plus avant-garde du monde de l’art depuis les années 1960. Attaché plus que tout à sa région, l’artiste travaille et vit depuis plus de 40 ans sur les hauteurs de Nice à Saint-Pancrace, dans une maison où chaque pièce peut devenir atelier, et où le manque progressif de place, l’a amené à créer une extension dont il nous ouvre aujourd’hui les portes.

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Spanish painter, Francisco de Goya. You will discover his labour with Lunch in the Countryside, The third of may 1808 or the Cannibals.

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Balanced Being: Open Your Hips and Strengthen Your Arms & Upper Back
programme.desc: Balanced Being is a powerful, flowing sequence that creates presence and strength. Use this practice to root down, then rise up with confidence and a centered, balanced energy. A study of complimentary opposites, this practice will challenge you to find the balance within the opposition.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: In this episode of Home Training, Guillaume and Sabrina guide you through a complete lower-body strengthening session. After a warm-up, they move on to targeted exercises for the thighs, abs, and glutes. Squats, lunges, and lateral raises are on the program to build strength and tone your body.

programme.title: Pilates
programme.desc: Stay in shape with our pilates courses!

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Balance and Bend: Balance and Connect
programme.desc: Stand tall and find your truest state of focus and center with this balancing flow. Use the breath to align your posture and learn to experience your practice, rather than thinking it through. Asanas, the physical yoga poses, then become a practice of feeling more than a mental exercise.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Today, it's the turn of Mickaël, 43, to enter the competition. From Vierzon, in the province of Namur, our man is a fan of decoration. In everyday life, he sells window frames. Mickaël has his own vision of decoration. So we've been warned, Mickaël has no intention of taking the easy way out. Except that our decorator still have to pay attention to the needs of the owners, Alice and Julien.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Cap au Nord pour découvrir une ville française absolument incontournable : Lille. Cette ville possède un patrimoine architectural exceptionnel, marchande dès le Moyen Age, citadelle sous Louis XIV, industrielle au XIXe...elle s'agrandit au cours des siècles. Julie ira à la rencontre de ceux qui participent à la renommée de la ville et de la région, et à travers son patrimoine culinaire avec au menu de ce voyage : la recette du coq à la bière, celle du hochepot, et sur une note sucrée, une crème brûlée à la chicorée. .

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: What a delight to find this springtime fruit! Strawberries bring color back to our plates and provide us with a healthy dose of vitamins and antioxidants. In this episode, Luana Belmondo reveals two sweet strawberry recipes.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pour les paresseux et tous ceux qui n’ont pas le temps, Luana Belmondo propose deux petites recettes simples et efficaces. Découvrez son pain à l'ail et au fromage, et ses spaghettis à l'ail.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Baie de Somme boasts an exceptional natural and historical heritage. From the emblematic medieval town of Saint-Valery-sur-Somme to the gardens of Valloires Abbey and the colorful villas of Mers-les-Bains, this episode reveals the richness of the Picardy coastline. Amid marshes, dunes and vast stretches of wilderness, the bay is also home to remarkable wildlife, best discovered alongside the enthusiasts who strive to preserve its beauty.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: Haut-RhinWelcome to Alsace, a land of tradition endowed with a heritage of incredible beauty! In the Haut-Rhin, we visit the mediaeval town of Riquewihr, whose wine is exported throughout the world, and Éguisheim, a veritable picture postcard village. Finally, we take a stroll through Colmar, the ''little Venice'' of Alsace.Directed by: Nicolas Coutand (season 1, France, 2014).

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: A land of character, Corrèze is full of hidden treasures. From Collonges-la-Rouge, a flamboyant red sandstone town, to the Cistercian abbey of Aubazine, and through Beaulieu-sur-Dordogne and its medieval heritage, each place bears witness to a rich past. But beyond its monuments, this region is also seductive for its untouched nature and its passionate inhabitants, guardians of an age-old legacy.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous emmène en Bretagne sud et plus précisément dans le quartier maritime du Guilvinec pour faire avec vous la route du poisson depuis les filets jusqu’à vos assiettes. Le Guilvinec a beau être le premier port de pêche artisanale français, tous les bords de mers de l’hexagone réservent de bons produits de saison. Julie remonte donc en voiture pour découvrir dans le sud un certain nombre de poissons d’élevage dans une ferme aquacole en Méditerranée, tout en cuisinant le bar à Noirmoutier, la lotte dans le Nord et même le cabillaud dans l’immense marché de Rungis. Julie a challengé le Chef Olivier Bellin installé à Plomodiern dans le Finistère, pour qu’il cuisine un poisson méconnu : la vieille.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Direction le Loir-et-Cher pour une chasse à courre encadrée par les équipes de l’ONCFS. Prenons ensuite la route des Vosges pour cuisiner aux côtés de Mauricette une savoureuse gigue de cerf. Allons à la rencontre de Pierre en Côte d’Or où il fabrique des trompes de chasse, un outil indispensable à la vénerie. Julie retrouvera aussi deux chasseurs girondins pour une après-midi de chasse à la tonne dès plus originale avant de rejoindre Joël en Aquitaine pour une autre recette de gibier à plume. Nous parlerons ensuite avec Laurent du métier de piqueux : ce dresseur de chiens destinés à la vénerie. Cette fois-ci ce sera Frédéric Robert qui nous concoctera une recette de lièvre frotté au cacao et cuit dans un sarcophage d’argile.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes her friend Suzie Palatin to prepare West Indian cuisine. On the menu: chicken colombo, with coconut blancmange for dessert.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, pumpkin takes center stage. Luana Belmondo cooks a spiced pumpkin velouté with parmesan shortbread. Next, she prepares pumpkin gnocchi with a creamy cheese sauce.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: Our season begins in Guatemala with an ascent up the mighty Fuego Volcano, one of the most active volcanoes in the world. As we climb through loose ash and steep ridges, the powerful rumble beneath our feet reveals the dynamic relationship between humans and the natural forces that shape our planet. The climb becomes both a physical challenge and a reminder of the deep connection between environment and well-being.After the volcano, we descend into the world of ancient healing with a traditional Temazcal lodge, where Mayan practitioners guide us through a powerful cleansing ritual using steam, herbs, and ceremony. Inside the dark, humid chamber, the experience becomes a profound demonstration of how culture, community, and spirituality intersect with health.Our journey continues at a coffee plantation, where we learn how altitude, soil, and sustainable farming practices impact not only flavour, but also community health and economic stability. By the end of the episode, we reconnect.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In this inspiring episode, we join Team Broken Earth on a medical mission in Guatemala, witnessing firsthand the life-changing work taking place in local hospitals. From dawn until night, Canadian and Guatemalan healthcare teams perform surgeries, consult patients, and provide care that is often out of reach for many families.We meet patients of all ages—children awaiting orthopedic procedures, adults seeking mobility restoration, elders who have endured years of pain. Their stories highlight the profound need for global medical partnerships and the impact compassionate care can have on entire communities.Inside the operating rooms, surgical teams work with extraordinary precision, focus, and teamwork. Outside, families wait with hope and gratitude. This episode is a tribute to the power of service, cultural exchange, and the shared humanity that defines global health. Helping others, we learn, is one of the most powerful forms of healing.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: Our culinary journey through Seoul begins with the smoky, flavour-rich world of Korean BBQ, where sizzling plates and communal dining embody the social heart of Korean culture. From there, we explore one of Seoul’s most iconic fish markets, where we try fresh king crab and live octopus while learning how the country's coastal heritage shaped its food traditions.Next, we visit the bustling herbal medicine market, where shelves overflow with ginseng, roots, mushrooms, and medicinal teas used for centuries in Traditional Korean Medicine. Here, local practitioners explain how balance, Qi, and seasonal eating contribute to long-term health.Our journey ends in Seoul’s thriving coffee scene, tasting artisan brews before joining your friend Chris for a peaceful riverside walk and dessert. This episode reveals that in Korea, food is more than nourishment—it is community, medicine, memory, and identity.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In a tranquil mountain monastery, Chef-Monk Jeong Kwan invites us into her world of mindful, intentional cooking. Her approach to food is rooted in simplicity, compassion, and a deep respect for nature. Together, we pick vegetables from the temple garden and learn why plant-based, seasonal eating has been central to Korean temple cuisine for generations.A highlight of the episode is learning the art of fermentation—from soy sauce aged in clay pots to rich, umami-packed bean pastes that require months or years to mature. Jeong Kwan explains that fermentation mirrors the human journey: slow, patient, and transformative.Cooking with her becomes a meditation, revealing that food prepared with intention nourishes not only the body but the spirit. This episode challenges us to rethink our relationship with ingredients, time, and the act of eating itself.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: On Jeju Island, home of the legendary Haenyeo divers, we experience one of the most awe-inspiring cultural traditions in the world. These women—many in their 60s, 70s, and 80s—dive deep into cold waters without oxygen tanks, harvesting shellfish and seaweed with incredible skill and stamina.Mike joins them, suiting up to attempt the dive himself. The comparison is humbling: while the Haenyeo descend gracefully and calmly, Mike struggles with breath-holding, buoyancy, and cold exposure. Their mastery is a testament to generations of practice, strength, and community support.After the dive, we cook the day’s catch together, sharing stories and laughter. This episode celebrates resilience, empowerment, and the extraordinary capabilities of women who have shaped the identity of Jeju for centuries.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: Our exploration of ancestry begins in London at the Genealogical Society, where archival records trace Mike’s family back nearly 300 years. With this new information, we travel to Wales, following the path of ancestors through rural landscapes and small villages that still carry the echoes of the past.The journey becomes hands-on as we try sheepdog herding, learning how shepherding has shaped Welsh culture. Next, we experience a unique mental health therapy involving hugging donkeys, discovering how animal connection can reduce stress and promote emotional well-being.With a local forager, we explore edible plants in the Welsh countryside, uncovering how communities have relied on the land for nourishment for generations. The journey concludes in a historic chapel where Mike stands on the exact spot where his ancestor was baptized three centuries earlier—a profound moment of connection across time.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: For the fourth day of competition, it's Anouchka, from Rhode-Saint-Genèse, who enters the arena. For as long as she can remember, decorating has been part of the life of this bubbly 45-year-old mum. A few years ago, Anouchka turned to painting and jewellery design. Professions that bring her closer to interior design, her real passion. To prove it she’ll have to stand out from the crowd. And what is our decorator's trademark?

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo puts the avocado in the spotlight, a fruit native to Mexico with numerous health benefits. She offers us a recipe for gambas with cucumber and avocado purée, as well as an avocado panna cotta with strawberry salad.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Impromptu aperitifs aren't always easy. When friends turn up unannounced, stress can quickly mount. Don't panic, Luana Belmondo and Thomas Clouet, a great specialist in the field, improvise an aperitif at the drop of a hat, using very little. Mushroom macaroons, a mini beef tartare and you're ready to go!

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Quercy region reveals architectural gems and enchanting landscapes. Rocamadour, a town clinging to its cliffs, Saint-Cirq-Lapopie, a picture-postcard village, and Castelnau-Bretenoux, a fairy-tale fortress, illustrate the richness of a land where tradition and history come together in perfect harmony.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Haut-Rhin is the epitome of Alsatian charm. Riquewihr and its grands crus, Eguisheim and its half-timbered houses, Colmar and its Little Venice reveal a region where architecture, gastronomy and vineyards come together to offer an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: Charente-Maritime is a 500-kilometer coastline that conceals an unsuspected heritage. From La Rochelle and its fortified port to the Ile de Ré and its salt marshes, to Talmont-sur-Gironde, a medieval village perched on the estuary, this region reveals itself through the tides and encounters. An immersion between maritime traditions and historical relics.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Nous entamerons ce périple près de la Rochelle pour en apprendre un peu plus sur l’élevage des fameuses moules de bouchot mais aussi une technique bien particulière pour les cuisiner. Nous partirons ensuite pour un tour de France des meilleures huîtres : direction Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier et enfin Oléron pour connaître les différentes méthodes d’élevage et s’y retrouver un peu plus parmi toutes les espèces de l’hexagone. Julie cuisinera une fricassée de berniques, les petits chapeaux chinois qui recouvrent les rochers du littoral mais aussi des palourdes roses méconnues du grand public. Nous poursuivrons notre route dans le Finistère pour rencontrer Sylvain, le seul éleveur d’ormeau du pays puis à Méru où se trouve encore des ateliers magnifiant ce sublime matériau. Le Chef Jean-Marie Baudic nous cuisine les coquilles Saint-Jacques comme personne.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo invites her friend Eleonora Galasso for a pizza party! First, they'll make homemade dough. Next, they'll cook a capriciosa with anchovies, capers and ham, and a pizza fritta with oregano and tomato sauce.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo cooks chickpeas. As they originate from the Middle East, she decides to prepare Lebanese recipes. On the menu: fallafel with chickpeas, kumquat, spices and cinnamon, and chard with chickpeas, parsley, mint and bulgur.

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week’s heat sees a pair of established designers taking on a less experienced up and coming pair, as they’re challenged to deliver amazing spaces on a budget of £5000, for a community park in Norris Green, Liverpool. Friends Sue Spout and Dean Bolton-Grant from Harrogate in Yorkshire both own their own garden businesses and between them have decades of experience and include royalty amongst the people they’ve worked for. Despite living opposite sides of the country Tamara Bridge and Kate Savill have collaborated on a number of show gardens since winning medals for young garden designer of the year. Faced with designing gardens for an open public area that has in the past been neglected and suffered from vandalism what type of gardens will the designers create? And who will be victorious?

The centre offers a lifeline to mainly elderly local people who have physical or mental disabilities or who live alone. With a brief from the centre that includes sensory elements, seating and a potting shed, both teams have ambitious designs but can they complete them in just 2 days?

Experienced garden designers and builders, James Hutchison and Stuart Gibson have travelled to the South Coast all the way from London. While their opponents, Manoj Maldé and Mark Holman, garden designers who collaborate on show gardens together, have only had to travel from Hertfordshire and Kent. With a brief that includes making sure the gardens are wheelchair friendly and low maintenance the teams come up with very different designs. James and Stuart are faced with a potentially disastrous problem they aren’t used to dealing with back in Scotland. But can they resolve it in time and finish their garden?

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.sub-title: Mysterious North: Land of Mountain Forests
programme.desc: Fra pangoliner, asiatiske palmesivetter og Delacours langurer til cat ba-langurer og de nylig oppdagede vitenamesiske krokodilleøglene. Vi ser på det utrolige utvalget av unike dyr som trives i de ekstreme forholdene som finnes i de skogkledde fjellene i Vietnam.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: Alpene er i endring, ikke gjennom dramatiske omveltninger, men sakte og gradvis. Stigende temperaturer og flere tiår med menneskelig påvirkning forandrer fjellområdet, som lenge har vært preget av stabile forhold. Steinbukker, murmeldyr og fjellryper møter ulike utfordringer i høyfjellet, men endringene åpner også for nye muligheter. Hvordan vil de ulike artene tilpasse seg? Nede i dalene truer endrede elveløp fuglearter som hekker på åpne grusbanker. Opplev en sårbar verden i stadig forandring.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Sommeren byr på overflod, men i kappløpet om å utnytte den korte varme årstiden følger også konkurranse, aggresjon og fare. Høyt oppe på fjellengene kjemper alpemurmeldyrene om de beste hiene der de kan oppfostre ungene sine. Men klarer de å unnslippe sultne bjørner? Bjørnungene i Karpatene vokser raskt, men trues av voksne hannbjørner som vil kvitte seg med rivalenes avkom. Klarer binnene å beskytte dem med sine smarte strategier? Flokker av europeisk bison dundrer gjennom de gamle skogene på jakt etter mat og vann. De er et av de fremste eksemplene på vellykket reintroduksjon, fordi tråkkene deres skaper liv i hele skogen og gir gode vilkår for milliarder av insekter. Insektene søker videre til kronhjortflokkene etter næring. Plaget av stikkende insekter trekker hjortene opp i fjellene for å slippe dem, men der risikerer de i stedet å bli bytte for sjeldne villkatter.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Høsten forvandler Karpatenes fjellsider til et bølgende teppe av bronse, ravgult og gull. Skogene fylles av kronhjortenes mektige brøl, som varsler kampen om retten til å samle en flokk med hinder. Oppgjørene er brutale, og de svekkede taperne blir et lett bytte for ulveflokker på jakt etter et enkelt måltid. For bjørnene gjelder det å fråtse i bær og nøtter for å legge på seg før vinterdvalen. Til tross for sin enorme størrelse klatrer de opp bøke- og furustammer for å nå de saftigste nøttene i trekronene. De går også inn på menneskenes åkere for å forsyne seg av mais. De gjør nesten hva som helst for å stille sulten. Alle disse storslåtte dyrenes overlevelse avhenger av de gamle skogene. De gamle trærne binder skadelig karbon fra atmosfæren og bidrar til å regulere jordas klima, en livsviktig funksjon for alt liv.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Alpebukker springer ned fra de bratte klippene, himmelen fylles av millioner av fugler under det imponerende trekket, og midt på vinteren leter den sjeldne gaupa etter en make.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Gjennom årstidens skiftende sykluser åpenbarer Spanias nasjonalpark Sierra de Gredos seg som et av Europas mest bemerkelsesverdige naturlandskap. Fra eldgamle isbreer og dype fjellkløfter til toppen av Pico Almanzor, det høyeste fjellet i sentrale Spania, kan du bli kjent med et unikt og sårbart økosystem. Her hersker den iberiske steinbukken, en ikonisk art som er innbegrepet av disse fjellene. Ved siden av den lever kongeørner, fjellfugler og otere i et område preget av isolasjon og motstandskraft. Dette er et portrett av villmark og balanse, et vindu inn i et av Europas siste store villmarksområder.

programme.desc: Sommeren byr på overflod, men i kappløpet om å utnytte den korte varme årstiden følger også konkurranse, aggresjon og fare. Høyt oppe på fjellengene kjemper alpemurmeldyrene om de beste hiene der de kan oppfostre ungene sine. Men klarer de å unnslippe sultne bjørner? Bjørnungene i Karpatene vokser raskt, men trues av voksne hannbjørner som vil kvitte seg med rivalenes avkom. Klarer binnene å beskytte dem med sine smarte strategier? Flokker av europeisk bison dundrer gjennom de gamle skogene på jakt etter mat og vann. De er et av de fremste eksemplene på vellykket reintroduksjon, fordi tråkkene deres skaper liv i hele skogen og gir gode vilkår for milliarder av insekter. Insektene søker videre til kronhjortflokkene etter næring. Plaget av stikkende insekter trekker hjortene opp i fjellene for å slippe dem, men der risikerer de i stedet å bli bytte for sjeldne villkatter.

programme.title: Into The Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Høsten forvandler Karpatenes fjellsider til et bølgende teppe av bronse, ravgult og gull. Skogene fylles av kronhjortenes mektige brøl, som varsler kampen om retten til å samle en flokk med hinder. Oppgjørene er brutale, og de svekkede taperne blir et lett bytte for ulveflokker på jakt etter et enkelt måltid. For bjørnene gjelder det å fråtse i bær og nøtter for å legge på seg før vinterdvalen. Til tross for sin enorme størrelse klatrer de opp bøke- og furustammer for å nå de saftigste nøttene i trekronene. De går også inn på menneskenes åkere for å forsyne seg av mais. De gjør nesten hva som helst for å stille sulten. Alle disse storslåtte dyrenes overlevelse avhenger av de gamle skogene. De gamle trærne binder skadelig karbon fra atmosfæren og bidrar til å regulere jordas klima, en livsviktig funksjon for alt liv.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: Det er regntid i Dogtown. Scarlett og familien forsterker hiet før flommen rammer dem, men de får også ubudne gjester før stormen kommer.

programme.title: Jaguar: Jungle Icon of Guyana
programme.desc: En ung jaguar skal til å dra ut på sitt aller viktigste oppdrag i livet: å finne sitt eget kongerike. Reisen tar ham gjennom varierte habitater, som alle har sitt eget utvalg av dyr. Det er kun om han kan bevise sin verdi at han kan ta tronen i et av de aller siste ville paradisene i verden.

programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: National Geographic blir med på en spennende reise over 445 kilometer for å utforske Grand Canyon og dens mysterier.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: Eiendomskrangler blir løst litt annerledes i Dogtown. I jakten på sitt første hi møter Pelt og Digit på grevlinger og præriehunder som beskytter territoriet sitt.

programme.title: Secrets of The Bullshark
programme.desc: Vi ved, at tyrehajer svømmer mod strømmen, og vi ved, at de jager i havet. Men vi har aldrig før kunnet se det som nu. Vi ser dem angribe og spise andre hajer. Vi ser deres lyssky jagter i dybet. Vi følger dem op ad ferskvandsfloder til yngleområder. Vi ser dem jage stimer af fisk fra droner i luften, og vi ser, når de støder sammen med flodheste og krokodiller.

programme.title: Big Little Giants
programme.desc: Med Botswanas vidstrakte og uberørte villmark som kulisse følger "Big Little Giants" Afrikas yngste dyr mens de tar sine første skritt inn i en utfordrende verden preget av tørke, rovdyr og eldgamle migrasjonsruter. Fra en nyfødt elefant som lærer å holde tritt med flokken, til sjakalunger som setter instinktene på prøve og gepardunger som forbereder seg på livet i forbløffende fart, hver historie utspiller seg gjennom intime øyeblikk preget av læring og tap. Godt hjulpet av foreldre, søsken og instinkt må de unge dyrene raskt tilpasse seg, ellers havner de på etterskudd. Gjennom fantastiske landskap og nærbilder ser du hvordan mot, familiebånd og motstandskraft er avgjørende for å overleve i den mest sårbare fasen av livet i naturen.

programme.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programme.desc: Blekkspruter er et av de mest bemerkelsesverdige dyrene på planeten, men de har en superkraft som setter dem høyt og over resten. Ved å endre farge hundrevis av ganger i timen eller forandre formen på kroppen for å etterligne deres dødeligste fiender, er de verdens mest ekstraordinære formskiftere.

programme.title: Dragens dag
programme.desc: For den største hann-komodovaranen på Rinca-øya setter stadig økende temperaturer og mindre jaktområder han i fare for å dø for hver time. På en utrolig reise får vi oppleve hverdagslivet til dette eldgamle rovdyret, og får se hvordan han tilpasser seg moderne endringer.

programme.title: Amur-tigeren
programme.desc: "Secret Kingdom of the Amur Tiger" tar oss med inn i et øde kongerike for å avsløre hemmelighetene til noen mektige tigre. Man bruker viltkameraer, zoomobjektiver og droner for å følge dyrene tett. Vi får se hvordan tigrene tar seg gjennom og lever side om side i smale passasjer, bruker hemmelige meldinger for å kommunisere med hverandre, jakter på bytter og utnytter årstidene. Det endelige målet er å finne en partner og føre arten videre.

programme.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programme.desc: Blekkspruter er et av de mest bemerkelsesverdige dyrene på planeten, men de har en superkraft som setter dem høyt og over resten. Ved å endre farge hundrevis av ganger i timen eller forandre formen på kroppen for å etterligne deres dødeligste fiender, er de verdens mest ekstraordinære formskiftere.

programme.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programme.desc: Bevæpnet med en ekstraordinær rekke superkrefter bryter Octopuses alle reglene når det kommer til dyrs intelligens. Født inn i verden som foreldreløse, er de selvlærte masterminds som er i stand til å løse komplekse problemer, legge strategier og til og med planlegge for fremtiden.

programme.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programme.desc: Selv om blekksprut alltid har vært antatt å være naturens ultimate ensomme, er sannheten at de viser overraskende sosial atferd. Fra mødre som henger med hverandre til å jobbe sammen med en annen art, disse bemerkelsesverdige skapningene er faktisk mer omgjengelige enn noen gang har forestilt seg.

programme.title: Killer Shark vs. Killer Whale
programme.desc: Vi studerer den utrolige hendelsen ved Farallon-øyene 45 km utenfor San Francisco i oktober 1997, der to spekkhoggere angrep og druknet en hvithai og rev ut leveren dens. Hendelsen var en gåte for forskerne, og siden har man sett flere lignende angrep. Man lurer på hva som foregår mellom to av havets kjemper, og det er fortsatt mange ubesvarte spørsmål.

programme.desc: Denne gangen må dyrene samles inn i "Den fantastiske dr. Pol". Veterinærene stilles overfor en rekke ulike saker: forgiftede valper, frekke katter, et besøk av en gammel venn som trenger hjelp og en unge som legger ut på eventyr alene.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Sommeren er på vei, men det kommer stadig nye klienter til Pols veterinærklinikk. Etter en travel uke trenger både mennesker og dyr en pause. I helgen bytter dr. Pol ut stetoskopet med fiskestangen da han og Diane tar en tur på sjøen.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: I planetens ville landskap bruker farlige rovdyr mer enn bare styrke for å holde seg på toppen av næringskjeden. For mange kan det å vite hva som skjuler seg i mørket være forskjellen mellom liv og død. Vi møter skapningene som har utrolige krefter som gir dem overtaket når mørket faller på.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: For å overleve ville landskap, matmangel og farlige rovdyr, trenger skapninger mer enn rå styrke for å overleve dagen. Dyr med superkrefter som en sjette sans klarer å få overtaket på hurtige bytter, overleve værforholdene og finne mat på usannsynlige steder.

programme.title: Afrikas elvegiganter
programme.desc: Afrikas kraftfulle elver huser et variert utvalg av beboere slik som elefanter og flodhester som spiser og drikker der krokodillene jakter og formerer seg. Vi avslører hvordan disse gigantiske dyrene ufrivillig deler vannet med andre, mindre skapninger slik som pinnsvin, kampørner og leoparder.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: I Highlands er Charlotte og Petal på leting etter nytt territorium. I Flatlands må Buttercup og søsknene hennes finne ut hvordan de kan overleve uten tilsyn av foreldre. Samtidig konkurrerer Gnash mot Carl og Champ i en spisekonkurranse som kan avgjøre hvem som har fordelen neste år, når dvalen er slutt.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa
programme.sub-title: Dyrehagens hemmeligheter: Tampa - en stjerne er født
programme.desc: ZooTampa har noen fantastiske dyr fra hele verden. Dyrene er vant til å få oppmerksomhet fra begeistrede gjester, men overraskende nok får de mest oppmerksomhet fra staben. Man blir bekymret da man finner en mystisk kul på en av ponniene. Mårbjørnene Sully og Melati flytter inn i sitt nye hjem. Teamet følger nøye med og håper at de oppstår varme følelser, men Melati lar seg ikke sjarmere så lett. Dyrehagen må ta farvel med sebraen Rafiki, men først steller de hovene hans. Hos pingvinene skal eggene klekkes, og dyrepasserne gleder seg til å ta imot en ny stjerne.

programme.title: Amerikas ville steder
programme.desc: Vi følger med JT Reynolds, Death Valleys store forkjemper, for å møte forskerne som jobber for å bevare det unike stedet.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: Det er vinter i New Mexico. I Highlands forbereder Carl og ungene seg på å gå i hi, men en uvanlig allianse mellom noen farlige rovdyr har skapt en stor trussel for præriehundene.

programme.title: Noe bet meg!
programme.desc: En elveguide i Zimbabwe møter mer enn sin match i forræderiske farvann. På tross av flere angrep som etterlater ham med 38 store bittsår, overlever han. På USAs nordvestkyst lider en helgeturist en fryktelig skjebne. Han blir angrepet av et sultent dyr og kjemper mot det for å redde seg selv og hundene.

programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa the Wild Side Updates
programme.desc: I Zoo Tampa tilpasser orangutangfamilien seg til livet med en ny baby.
